library_argument.name: library_name
library_argument.description: Path to the SQLite source library. Append .sqlite when no extension is given; reject other extensions.

batch_argument.name: continue_on_error
batch_argument.description: Continue reading batch commands after an error; the final exit status remains nonzero.

commands.name: configure_library
commands.summary: Change library settings.

arguments.name: build_command
arguments.description: Shell command run after extraction, from the library directory. The output target is $1 on Linux or %SCU_BUILD_OUTPUT% on Windows.

arguments.name: comment_prefix
arguments.description: Default comment prefix for new decks. Set it before the current version receives its first revision.

arguments.name: editor
arguments.description: Editor executable and arguments as a JSON array.

arguments.name: revision_increment
arguments.description: Step for new revisions of a deck, in thousandths. The default is 0.001.

arguments.name: version_increment
arguments.description: Step for automatically starting a library version, with up to ten fractional digits. The default is 0.01.

arguments.name: release_directory
arguments.description: Directory for release publication, relative to the library directory. Default release; must be separate from working sources.

arguments.name: file_patterns
arguments.description: Monitored root filenames and wildcards as a JSON array of strings. An empty array clears the list.

arguments.name: platform
arguments.description: Record the creation platform once for a library whose platform is unknown.

arguments.name: version_tracker
arguments.description: Output filename for the library-wide version tracker template. An empty value disables generation.

arguments.name: tracker_template_file
arguments.description: Read the version tracker template from a UTF-8 text file (up to 1 MiB) and refresh the generated working tracker when the template changes.

commands.help: Supply one or more settings. To inspect their current values, run display_library.

commands.name: create_deck
commands.summary: Create an empty deck or initialize it from a file.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the new deck.

arguments.name: from_file
arguments.description: Path to the initial source. Omit to create an empty deck.

arguments.name: comment_prefix
arguments.description: Comment prefix for this deck. Omit to use the current version's default.

commands.help: Choose a name that is available in the current unlocked version. To update an existing deck from a working file, use import_deck.

examples.description: Create an empty deck.
Use the file's bytes as the initial source.

commands.name: create_version
commands.summary: Start a new library version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: New library version. Omit to advance by version_increment.

commands.help: Lock the current version first. SCU inherits its decks and refreshes the configured version tracker.

commands.name: delete_deck
commands.summary: Remove a deck from the current unlocked version.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the existing deck to delete. Defaults to the last modified deck.

commands.help: SCU records a deletion and keeps earlier revisions. Remove the working file yourself if a later pattern import should not recreate the deck.

examples.description: Delete main.pas from the current open version while retaining its history.

commands.name: delete_version
commands.summary: Remove the current unlocked version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Exact name of the current open version to remove.

arguments.name: delete_revisions
arguments.description: Delete all deck revisions stored in the selected version.

commands.help: The preceding locked version becomes current. To delete a version containing revisions, explicitly set delete_revisions=yes. Working files stay on disk.

commands.name: display_audit_trail
commands.summary: Show recent commands and their outcomes.

arguments.name: number_of_lines
arguments.description: Maximum number of recent command attempts to display.

commands.help: Entries appear in chronological order with command names and arguments expanded.

commands.name: display_command
commands.summary: Show how to use a command.

arguments.name: command_name
arguments.description: Full command name or alias to look up.

commands.help: Look up a full name or abbreviation, such as disc extd for extract_deck.

commands.name: display_command_list
commands.summary: List commands with their abbreviations and descriptions.
commands.help: For arguments and examples, enter disc followed by a command name.

commands.name: display_deck
commands.summary: Show a deck's revision history.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck whose revision history to show.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Number of most recent deck history entries to show. Default 10; use 0 for the complete history.

commands.help: The newest revisions appear first, with their local modification times and stored or deleted status. Use limit=0 for the full history.

examples.description: Show the revision history of the last modified deck.
Show the complete revision history of the last modified deck.

commands.name: display_deck_diff
commands.summary: Compare two revisions of one deck.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck to compare in both snapshots.

arguments.name: from_snapshot
arguments.description: Deck version, scu$current_deck_version, or scu$previous_deck_version. Omit to use the deck version immediately before the right endpoint.

arguments.name: to_snapshot
arguments.description: Deck version, scu$current_deck_version, or scu$previous_deck_version. Omit to use the deck's latest version.

arguments.name: ignore_space_changes
arguments.description: Ignore trailing whitespace and changes in the amount of existing whitespace. Set no to compare whitespace exactly.

arguments.name: output_format
arguments.description: Diff output format: normal shows changed lines only; unified shows three lines of unchanged context. Default normal.

commands.help: With no arguments, compare the last modified deck's latest revision with its preceding revision. To compare all decks across two library versions, use disvd.

examples.description: Compare the last modified deck with its prior revision.
Compare two exact deck versions within one library version.
Compare an exact deck version with the latest version of the deck.
Compare the latest revision of main.pas with its preceding revision.
Show unified output with three context lines.

commands.name: display_deck_list
commands.summary: List the decks available in a library version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version whose visible decks to list, including inherited decks. Defaults to scu$current_version.

commands.help: Inherited decks appear with the deck version in which their source was last stored. To list only decks revised in this library version, use disv.

examples.description: See which decks are available in named version 1.1.
List decks in the latest saved snapshot of the current version.

commands.name: display_library
commands.summary: Show the library path, current version, and settings.

arguments.name: json
arguments.description: Print the complete library header as JSON, including version history.

commands.help: The summary includes the current lock status and the preceding locked version. SCU shows it when you open a library at the interactive prompt.

commands.name: display_version
commands.summary: List decks revised in a library version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version whose changed decks to list. Defaults to the current library version.

commands.help: Each deck appears once, at its final revision in that version. A status such as 'matches 8.132' means its source bytes match the preceding locked version.

examples.description: Show changed decks in the current library version.
Show decks changed in version 1.1, including deletions.

commands.name: display_version_diff
commands.summary: Compare all decks across two library versions.

arguments.name: from_version
arguments.description: Starting library version for the comparison.

arguments.name: to_version
arguments.description: Ending library version for the comparison.

arguments.name: ignore_space_changes
arguments.description: Ignore trailing whitespace and changes in the amount of existing whitespace. Set no to compare whitespace exactly.

arguments.name: output_format
arguments.description: Normal shows changed lines and a summary. Unified shows three lines of context and omits the summary.

arguments.name: ignore_legacy_scu_header
arguments.description: Ignore lines beginning with the deck's comment prefix followed by ' SCU REVISION '. Set no to compare those lines.

commands.help: With no arguments, compare the previous locked version with the current version. The default output shows changed lines and a per-deck summary. Use unified output for a patch.

examples.description: Compare the previous locked library version with the current version.
Compare two named library versions.
Produce a textual patch for patch -p1, including whitespace and legacy header changes.

commands.name: display_version_history
commands.summary: Show library versions and their lock descriptions.

arguments.name: display_description
arguments.description: Show only the first description line (short), or the complete description (full).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Number of most recent versions to show, including the current version. Default 10; use 0 for all versions.

commands.help: The default view shows the ten most recent versions, oldest first. Use display_description=full to read multiline descriptions below each version.

examples.description: Show each full description below its version, with real line breaks.
Show the five most recent versions, including the current one.
Show the complete version history.
Show the first description line for every version.
Show complete descriptions for the five most recent versions.

commands.name: edit_deck
commands.summary: Edit a stored deck in the configured editor.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the existing deck to edit.

commands.help: Save and close the editor to record a revision if the source bytes changed.

commands.name: edit_file_patterns
commands.summary: Choose which working files import_deck monitors.
commands.help: In the configured editor, enter one filename or wildcard per line. Patterns apply directly to the library directory. Save an empty list to clear the selection.

examples.description: Edit entries such as *.pas, *.inc, and Makefile, one per line.

commands.name: edit_version_tracker
commands.summary: Edit the template for the generated version file.
commands.help: Save and close the configured editor to refresh the working tracker. SCU preserves local edits to the generated file.

commands.name: extract_deck
commands.summary: Write the original source bytes to a file.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Name of the deck to extract.

arguments.name: output_file
arguments.description: Destination for the source. Defaults to the recorded filename beside the library, or the deck name if no filename was recorded.

arguments.name: revision
arguments.description: Deck revision within the selected version (0.000 to 0.999). Omit to use the latest visible revision, including inherited source.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version to extract from. Select a revision separately or use a complete deck version such as 1.1-0.001.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Allow replacing working files whose bytes match no surviving revision of the selected deck.

arguments.name: build
arguments.description: Run the configured build command after extraction, from the library directory.

commands.help: Restore a deck under its recorded filename, including COPY directives and macro text. SCU also refreshes the configured version tracker and runs the configured build.

examples.description: Retrieve the source from named version 1.1, such as a locked release.

examples.command: scu extract_deck main.pas before-fix.pas version=1.1 revision=0.001
examples.description: Select deck revision 0.001 stored in library version 1.1.
Write the last modified deck to its recorded source filename beside the library.

commands.name: extract_version
commands.summary: Restore all working files from a library version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version to extract completely, including inherited decks. Defaults to scu$current_version without prompting.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Directory for original source files. Defaults to the library directory.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Allow replacing working files whose bytes match no surviving revision of the selected deck.

arguments.name: build
arguments.description: Run the configured build command after extraction, from the library directory.

commands.help: Extract every live deck, including inherited decks, and refresh the configured version tracker. SCU lists overwrite conflicts before writing and runs the configured build once after extraction.

examples.description: Extract all decks in the current library version with their deck filenames.
Extract all live decks from the current version with their deck filenames beside the library.

commands.name: import_deck
commands.summary: Record working file changes in the open version.

arguments.name: deck_name
arguments.description: Deck to create, revise, or recreate. Omit to snapshot file_patterns in the library directory.

arguments.name: source_file
arguments.description: Bare source filename in the library directory. Directory components and absolute paths are errors. Defaults to the deck's recorded filename. Requires deck_name.

arguments.name: comment_prefix
arguments.description: Comment prefix for new or changed revisions. Omit to retain each deck prefix or use the version default for new decks.

commands.help: Name a deck to import one file. With no arguments, scan file_patterns in the library directory and record new, changed, and missing files together. After saving, SCU refreshes the configured version tracker.

examples.description: Snapshot all configured file patterns, including deletions and unchanged-file counts.
Import main.pas from its source path in the library directory.

commands.name: initialize_library
commands.summary: Create an empty source library.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Initial library version in MAJOR.MINOR form. Defaults to 1.0.

commands.help: The initial version is unlocked and ready for your first deck.

commands.name: lock_version
commands.summary: Lock the current version and record a description.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: Describe the changes completed in this version. Omit this argument at the SCU prompt or in a terminal invocation to write a multiline description in the configured editor.

arguments.name: import_manifest_file
arguments.description: Read archive import metadata for this version from a JSON file when locking it.

commands.help: Import any working file edits you want to include before locking. At a terminal, omit the description to write it in the configured editor.

examples.description: Lock the current version and describe its changes.

commands.name: quit_session
commands.summary: Leave the interactive session.
commands.help: Successful changes have already been saved.

commands.name: recover_library
commands.summary: Restore a recovery file to a new SQLite library.

arguments.name: recovery_file
arguments.description: SCU recovery JSON file to restore.

arguments.name: base_library
arguments.description: Saved SQLite snapshot if the pending-only file references saved revisions.

commands.help: Choose a new library path. If the recovery file contains only pending changes, supply the saved library it was based on.

commands.name: release_version
commands.summary: Publish a library version with release macros expanded.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version to publish completely, including inherited decks. Default scu$current_version.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Release output directory. Default to release_directory (release beside the library); cannot be the working-source directory.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Explicitly replace edited outputs or remove untracked matching release files. SQLite storage and working sources remain protected.

commands.help: Publish every live deck, including inherited decks, to the release directory. SCU expands SCU$VERSION, SCU$DECK_VERSION, SCU$DATE, SCU$TIME, and SCU$DATE_TIME. It removes obsolete tracked files matching file_patterns and skips the build.

examples.description: Publish the complete current version to release/ with macros expanded.
Publish a complete selected release, including inherited decks; remove obsolete matching files.

commands.name: rename_version
commands.summary: Rename the current unlocked library version.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Exact current version name.

arguments.name: new_version
arguments.description: New MAJOR.MINOR name, greater than the previous locked version.

commands.help: Stored revisions take the new version name and keep their revision numbers. SCU also refreshes the configured version tracker.

examples.description: Correct the current version name after locking 8.1307.

commands.name: save_library
commands.summary: Confirm that the library has been saved.
commands.help: SCU saves each successful change automatically. You can use this command to confirm the saved state during a session.

commands.name: unlock_version
commands.summary: Reopen the current locked version for editing.
commands.help: Existing deck revisions are preserved. Lock the version again to record a new description and lock time.

commands.name: verify_audit_trail
commands.summary: Check the integrity of the audit trail.

arguments.name: head
arguments.description: Previously saved SHA-256 digest to look for in the audit chain.

commands.help: SCU checks the full hash chain. Supply a previously saved head to confirm the trail still includes that record.

commands.name: verify_decks
commands.summary: Check working or released files against the library.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Directory to verify. Default to the library directory. Use scu$release_directory to verify the published release.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Library version whose latest visible decks to verify. Defaults to scu$current_version.

commands.help: In a working directory, SCU compares each live deck with its file and ignores extra files. In a release directory, it checks the expanded files against the release manifest. Files needing attention are listed at the end.

examples.description: Verify working files in the library directory against the current version.
Check the published release using its manifest.
